name: Aksharantar (AI4Bharat), Maithili
licence_source: https://huggingface.co/datasets/ai4bharat/Aksharantar/raw/main/README.md (Licensing Information, read 2026-11-06): "Manually collected data: Released under CC-BY license. Mined dataset (from Samanantar and IndicCorp): Released under CC0 license. Existing sources: Released under CC0 license." Same terms as the Malayalam file (aksharantar.json); the same source filter is applied.
attribution: Aksharantar by AI4Bharat (Madhani et al., 2022), CC BY and CC0. Includes names from Wikidata (CC0).
verdict_reason: The Maithili files have 75,257 Existing rows, which the filter in training/mlkb/langs/human.py drops (the tools keep only mined, Wikidata and manual rows). What is kept is mined (IndicCorp, Samanantar: CC0), Wikidata (CC0) or AI4Bharat's manual collection (AK-Freq, AK-NEF, AK-NEI, AK-Uni: CC BY).
used_for: mai_train.json rows (IndicCorp with mining score >= -0.2, Samanantar, Wikidata) as transliterator training pairs for packs/mai.neopack, and to fit and check the romanised Maithili tables (data/langs/mai/romanisation.json). mai_valid.json manual rows (AK-Freq, AK-Uni) calibrate the tables and validate training. mai_test.json's manual rows (CC BY) are the held-out eval set: their words are left out of every training pair.
notes: Fetched 2026-11-11. Extract with: unzip mai.zip -d data/raw/aksharantar-mai/extracted (data/build-mai-text.sh does). mai_train.json has 282,639 rows: IndicCorp 201,471, Existing 75,257, AK-Freq 4,469, Wikidata 1,442. mai_valid.json has 3,790 rows: IndicCorp 1,962, AK-Freq 982, AK-Uni 809, Wikidata 37. mai_test.json has 5,449 rows: AK-Freq 3,471, AK-NEI 1,164, AK-NEF 814. The CC0 statement says 'We do not own any of the text from which this data has been extracted': mined pairs are single words, which we treat as unprotectable on their own.
status: in packs/mai.neopack, a trial pack handed out as a file (credited in its manifest); not published on the site, not in the app
